# SENTINEL

> A structural immune system: a verify-before-parse signed-packet gate, a capability budget, a κ-witness, and a grown anomaly detector, sealed against a red-team battery.

Sealed, being measured. The packet, the gate, the attack shapes, the rules and a prediction were committed before the battery ran; the result lands here whichever way it goes.
